title: What It Actually Looks Like to Doubt and Still Follow Christ
caption:
A lot of guys think doubt means they're out. So they fake certainty on Sunday and quietly drift the rest of the week.

There's another way. Say it out loud to God and one brother. Keep praying and reading while your feelings catch up. Write down the real question and take it to someone who's wrestled with it. Thomas doubted, stayed in the room, and Jesus met him there.

Save this for the season when it's hard to believe.

#faith #godlyman #doubt #christianmen
